findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile vendoring marklas with the stdlib-only reconciler contract (adf.py:3, pyproject.toml:61): state explicitly why the always-imported Cloud codec path may carry a third-party parser inline, or gate it behind an opt-in extra / lazy import as every other third-party dep (e.g. the DC jira backend) is.
evidence: adf.py:3 (real path src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/adf.py): 'Standalone module with no external dependencies (stdlib only).'
pyproject.toml:61: 'Everything else — the engine core and the reconciler — remains stdlib-only.' and :68-69 the reconciler 'ships as package data under rebar/_engine/' and is 'stdlib-only'

The comparable rich-text codec dependency — the DC Jira backend — is an opt-in extra imported lazily (pyproject.toml:174-182, jira>=3.8,<4, 'imported lazily so a non-adopting client (Cloud-only, or no reconciler at all) pays nothing'); Cloud's adapters/jira/ has no such extra
adf.py is on the always-imported Cloud codec path (AdfCodec pass-through over it), so a module-scope marklas import is not lazy/optional
findings.finding: Vendoring marklas (a mistune-based parser) and importing it from adf.py places a third-party runtime dependency on the Cloud reconciler path, which is documented as stdlib-only; the plan never reconciles this with that contract.
scenarios: A Cloud-only or lean install imports the reconciler and now carries a mistune-based parser inline, growing the previously dependency-free reconciler surface
A reviewer or the stdlib-only contract owner rejects the new third-party parser on the reconciler path

resolve_symbol UNRESOLVED for every ADF->Markdown decode name probed: adf_to_markdown, to_markdown, from_adf, adf_to_md, md_to_adf, marklas.adf.to_markdown, render, Renderer (UNRESOLVED is not proof of absence, but the plan names no concrete decode API to verify against)

Downstream ticket 3388 depends on decode_inbound (=adf_to_markdown) for the codec law normalize_outbound(t)==decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) (test_rich_text_codec.py:163), so the decode direction is load-bearing

The ADF->Markdown decode that adf_to_markdown wraps — the half the plan says adf.py lacks, and the piece downstream story 3388's codec law depends on — is never named to a concrete marklas function, and no obvious decode symbol resolves in the installed marklas.
